outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Panel B shows H&E-stained micrographs of intestinal sections, not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, distribution already shown) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp numbers per diameter category across genotypes (n=8–18 per genotype). The bar chart represents averaged data but shows no overlaid individual data points from the mice used.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 (relative to total) shows only mean bars with error bars and no individual data points overlaid.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot; the check does not apply.
The bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows mean bars with error bars but no individual data points are overlaid.
